_comment: BAND-SPLIT. Band-local spawns for band3_the_river_lock. `order` is this entry's index in the merged array and is the ONLY thing that decides merge position -- never file order, never band order. Existing entries keep the index they had before the split because encounter_director.gd seeds each cluster's scatter, level roll, IVs, traits and shiny draw from it (hash("wild_spawn_%d" % order)), so changing a number moves creatures and rerolls them. A new entry in this band takes an unused order in this band's reserved range 3000-3999, which no other band can collide with; do not renumber an existing one.
